messages:
eli_devex: FYI I opened a tiny PR that normalizes header encoding + bumps default retry to 3. CI is red on some Ruby matrices, odd.
devops-bot: CI failed — matrix: ruby-2.5, jruby-9.2, ruby-3.0. See job 8421. :x:
jess: can you paste the failing log? quick look pls
eli_devex: sure — error from bundle step:
```
Fetching gem metadata from https://rubygems.org/.........
Bundler could not find compatible versions for gem "rack"
  In snapshot (Gemfile.lock): rack (= 2.2.3)
  In Gemfile: sampleapp (>= 0) was resolved to 0.1.0, which depends on rack (~> 1.6)
```
eli_devex: sampleapp's dev Gemfile pins rack ~>1.6 for old test matrix; my PR changed default header sanitizer to use `String#byteslice` for speed which is fine, but default retry change surfaced the older-deps matrix more often.
ryan_eng: hmm — the core SDK change shouldn't affect Gem resolution unless CI job pulled the sampleapp path and runs `bundle update` accidentally. Is the job doing that? @devops-bot any env differences?
devops-bot: Job runs `cd sampleapp && bundle install --path vendor/bundle` for the matrix. ruby-2.5 job uses bundler 1.x in the image.
jess: bundler 1.x + Gemfile.lock mismatch — we used to rely on lockfile pruning in CI. PR touches sampleapp launcher that runs `bundle install --deployment` in a dry-run; looks like that step now triggers full install on older images.
connie_research: For context, other SDKs (go/py) didn't change retry defaults in last minor; parity question: do we want retry default 3 across SDKs? If so we should coordinate and do a minor semver release, not a patch.
eli_devex: agree, parity matters. I can revert the retry bump in this PR and keep the encoding change.
sam_support: prefer revert + follow-up changelog entry and a cross-SDK issue. Also we should stop testing ruby-2.5 in CI now that it's EOL — but keep a gated legacy job for enterprise customers.
ryan_eng: concrete fix suggestion:
```
- DEFAULT_RETRY = 3
+ DEFAULT_RETRY = ENV.fetch("REDWOOD_RUBY_DEFAULT_RETRY", 1).to_i
```
That keeps behavior stable unless teams opt-in.
jess: nice. For the Gemfile issue, I'll update the sampleapp CI step to use `bundle _2.3.16_ install` on newer matrices and leave legacy job as-is.
eli_devex: pushed a tiny revert for retry and tweaked the CI to avoid `bundle update` call. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/412
jess: reviewing now. If tests green I'll merge and we can open a follow-up to align defaults across SDKs.
connie_research: please also add a short note in the PR about rationale for encoding change and why it is safe for older Rubies (fallback path included).
sam_support: after merge can we cut a 0.12.3 patch with only the encoding fix? need to backport to the supported patch line.
eli_devex: sure — will mark change for cherry-pick once merged. thanks all :tada:
jess: merged and released 0.12.3-pre. Observability CI looks green now. :shipit:
eli_devex: awesome, thanks everyone :)
